reasons: The cited Article is a pure "AS IS" disclaimer that also expressly negates any obligation to correct nonconformity to documentation — this is the rule's walk-away position, so a deviation finding with an inserted warranty is correct, not over-flagging.

The redline is actionable and complete for the rule: it carves the express warranties out of the disclaimer ("EXCEPT FOR THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES SET FORTH IN THIS ARTICLE") and inserts workmanlike-performance, 12-month software / 90-day services conformance, legal compliance and no-malicious-code warranties with a repair/replace/refund remedy, tracking the model language.

Edit scope is proportionate: the existing disclaimer text is preserved apart from the necessary carve-out prefix, and the new obligation is added as a separate paragraph; the 0.370 changed-character ratio on p0110 reflects a short prefix insertion, not a rewrite.

The comment is accurate (no affirmative warranty or remedy exists), cites the playbook position, offers the 90-day fallback, and matches the required concise first-person-plural tone with the correct prefix.
